typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CONTACT_ID as string,
		NOTES as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_contactnote*']) ~> source1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 split(isNull(CONTACT_ID)||isNull(NOTES),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(rejectNULL, toSFDC)
ConditionalSplit1@rejectNULL derive(REJECT_REASON = iif(isNull(CONTACT_ID)||isNull(NOTES), 
concat('ADF:Field contain NULL value: ', iif(isNull(CONTACT_ID), 'CONTACT_ID ', ''), iif(isNull(NOTES), 'NOTES ', '')), toString(null()))) ~> rejectREASON
rejectREASON select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit1@toSFDC derive(Notes_Type__c = case(startsWith(CONTACT_ID, '003'), 'Member', startsWith(CONTACT_ID, '00Q'), 'Medicare'),
		Name = concat(toString(currentUTC(), 'MM/dd/yyyy:HH:mm'), case(startsWith(CONTACT_ID, '003'), '_Member', startsWith(CONTACT_ID, '00Q'), '_Medicare')),
		SObject_Name__c = case(startsWith(CONTACT_ID, '003'), 'Contact', startsWith(CONTACT_ID, '00Q'), 'Lead'),
		Contact__c = case(startsWith(CONTACT_ID, '003'), CONTACT_ID),
		Lead__c = case(startsWith(CONTACT_ID, '00Q'), CONTACT_ID)) ~> DerivedColumn4
DerivedColumn4 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Notes__c = NOTES,
		Notes_Type__c,
		SObject_Name__c,
		Contact__c,
		Lead__c,
		Name
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select4
DerivedColumn1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_contactnote_raw.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedInbound
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_contactnote_source_reject.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> rejectOUTPUT
Select4 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_contactnote_Notes__c.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertNotes
